description: Returns a private foundation's profile by EIN, from its filed IRS 990-PF returns: location, assets, annual giving, application information as filed, and giving pattern. The optional section returns grant history, repeat grantees, leaders as listed in a dated filing, or overlap with federal assistance records, each with its own filters and paging; the answer says when a section is not available to the account. Grant lines that may name an individual person are withheld. Only private foundations (990-PF filers) are covered. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Does not count toward the search allowance.

assistance_listing_number.description: For federal_connections, filter by Assistance Listing number such as 93.855.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the prior page.

ein.description: 9-digit EIN of a private foundation (990-PF filer); a dash after the second digit is accepted. Example: 911663695.

limit.description: Rows per page (default 25, max 100). Federal connections uses page-number pagination; grant history and repeat grantees return opaque cursors.

maximum_amount.description: For grant_history, maximum amount per reported line.

minimum_amount.description: For grant_history, minimum amount per reported line.

minimum_years.description: For repeat_grantees, minimum covered filing years (2+).

recipient.description: Organization name matched against grant-history or repeat-grantee rows.

section.description: Foundation section: public_profile (default), grant_history, repeat_grantees, leadership (people and titles as listed in a dated filing) or federal_connections (overlap with federal assistance records). Some sections depend on the account; the answer says when a section is not available.

state.description: For grant_history or federal_connections, filter by 2-letter recipient state.

year.description: For grant_history, filter by filing year.

name: get_foundation
title: Get Foundation Details
